{{Top|leg}}
'''Buuper Torsckil Abbey Devices''' was a major [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturer from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. It produced the [[Porax-38 starfighter|Utapaun P-38 Fighter]].
